claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria was a Christian theologian, teacher, and head of the Catechetical School in Alexandria who lived circa 185–254 CE.
They were part of a systematic program to read the entire Old Testament and Gospel, with separate non‑Eucharistic meetings for catechumens and Eucharistic meetings for full members of the church.
The immediate occasion was that after the persecutions of Maximinus Daia, the bishop Theoctistus assigned Origen the responsibility of delivering these homilies.

The homilies are valuable for historians because they provide insight into third‑century Christian theology, liturgical practice, and the development of Trinitarian doctrine that later influenced fourth‑ and fifth‑century debates.
